claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_creature_communication
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Speak with Animals grants the caster the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with a specific creature type (Beasts) for the duration. This is not a sensory extension (grant_sense), not a directed mental link (telepathic_link), and not a proficiency grant. It is a distinct effect: enabling cross-species linguistic comprehension and verbal communication for a bounded duration. No v4 atom covers this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation::grant_capability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing_effect family's OngoingOperation is currently closed to roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Speak with Animals requires an operation variant that grants a capability (communication, interaction) for the duration. Without this variant, the ongoing_effect family cannot represent spells whose persistent effect is granting an ability rather than modifying a roll or adding damage.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_action_option_access
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell also grants access to the Influence action's skill options against a restricted creature type (Beasts). This is a distinct effect from communication: it expands which action sub-options are available when targeting a creature of a given type. No v4 atom models 'grant access to action skill options for a creature type subset'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime::action_or_ritual
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Speak with Animals is castable as a standard 1 Action OR as a Ritual (11 minutes). The current CastingTime type forces a single choice: either { kind: 'action' } or { kind: 'minutes', amount: 11, ritual: true }. A spell that has both a standard casting time and a ritual variant cannot be represented accurately in a single CastingTime field. This is a secondary gap compared to the operation atom gap, but it is a real surface limitation for all ritual-capable spells with a sub-minute standard casting time.
